chapter: Danny's rise through New York bands to Cab Calloway
title: Danny recalls his mother's song When You Feel My Leg
summary: Danny remembered a risque song his mother used to sing, which became Don't You Feel My Leg.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: All right. So I go to Mel Williams. So he said, "Well, would you..." He looked at Lu and said, "Yes, you can sing, but we need something more." So he said, "Think of something raunchy, and come back." So I get back home, and I think "What was that thing that my mother used to sing, 'When you feel my leg'..." "When you feel my leg..." I said, "What else?" She used to sing, "When you feel my leg, when you feel my thighs..." I don't know where my mother got that from. It's (?) original, because I never heard nobody else sing it...
Because they would come out and tell you if it got taken from them.
